neighbours.label: The token ' rib' / 'Rib' / 'rib' in any sense, including as a word piece (rib cage, prime rib, ribbed, ribosome, ribbing, midrib); not the whole-word token ' ribbon'
neighbours.notes: Word-level label, chosen by Twitch chat vote over a broader 'rib(s)' word label and a meaning-level 'anatomical/structural ribs' label. Probes showed meaning-independence (teasing 'ribbing' and 'ribosome' fire as hard as rib cage); whole-word ' ribbon' and ' ribs' fire weakly or variably, so plural ribs are kept out of the test. The parent vein neuron L7/N1548- shows the feed directly: in its inverse solver run 'midrib' was the near-miss ceiling (0.61, peak on 'rib'). ' vein' itself gives this pole about 0.34.
